notes.title: "Eggo" Demo Version Now Available!
notes.content: [p](｡･∀･)ﾉﾞHi! Dear online fur baby caregivers：[/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the demo version of "Eggo" is finally live! After months of development, you can now join your friends to raise your beloved Eggos![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610478/c33b842e8515c29ea32051e985ec3c78935eab0e.png"][/img][/p][p]Here’s what's new in the demo version of "Eggo":[/p][p]Gameplay:[/p][olist][*][p]Multiplayer Mode is here! Now you can raise cute pets with your friends![/p][/*][*][p]Beginner’s Tutorial is available – new players can easily jump in![/p][/*][*][p]Free Decoration, Family Tree, and Albums have all been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking Hall gameplay has been improved for more fun![/p][/*][*][p]Genetic Inheritance system is optimized, making breeding more fun.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Appearance Updates:[/p][olist][*][p]3 new outfits (have 8 colors), upgrading Eggo’s fashion.[/p][/*][*][p]New eyes ×2, new ears ×3, and new whiskers ×2 (all with multiple color options).[/p][/*][*][p]1 new facial feature.[/p][/*][*][p]1 new furniture color set.[/p][/*][*][p]A total of 17 skin tones now available, giving you more customization space![/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you all for your continuous support! We are committed to listening to every player's feedback and incorporating those suggestions into our game. [url="https://discord.gg/5p2HcDQh"]Welcome to our discord[/url], and please continue supporting "Eggo"![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3992160/_Demo/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: ✨The Playtest Version of "Eggo" is Now Live!
notes.content: [p]Dear friends, we are excited to announce:[/p][p]"Eggo" is finally here![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610478/cd24192a2672be84b54f770c001bc3826bbe8183.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this Playtest version, you’ll get to experience raising a cute little "Eggo", enjoying its warm companionship while you work or study, and even breeding the Eggo of your dreams.[/p][p][/p][p]As a game created in just 2 people and 2 weeks, the launch of "Eggo" wouldn't have been possible without the trust and support from all of you. Your encouragement is our driving force, and we will keep working hard to make "Eggo" even better in the future. Please continue supporting "Eggo"![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700760/_Eggo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
